cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pay the climbing-course deposit before we discuss the cliff. I taught you to fasten a harness one buckle at a time; start with this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're checking the commitment first now. Good. The deposit comes back if you attend the first lesson; staying home costs twenty pounds.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So paying makes not climbing harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It gives us twenty pounds to go and collect. You trusted my first harness check; trust me with the first lesson. Pay the twenty and put Saturday in your diary.
